title: Senior Manager, Competitions Rights Delivery
location: Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
description: “Be at the heart of football in Asia, deliver world-class media experiences that bring the game to millions.” We are currently looking for a Senior Manager, Competitions Rights Delivery who is passionate, proactive, and ready to lead. In this role, you will ensure seamless media and broadcast operations across AFC competitions and events. You’ll oversee accreditation, infrastructure, information, documentation, and stakeholder relations, driving world-class experiences for media, broadcasters, and fans alike. Responsibilities: - Early dissemination of application details to media representatives and media rights partners. Competent administration of the Media Channel and Agency Channel portals. Clear communication and coordination with the LOC and DMA Unit on accreditation card production and distribution. Conduct detailed site inspections to identify venue deficiencies and recommend necessary remedial actions. Provide proper briefings and training to LOC media staff and volunteers. Develop and maintain the Media Guide, including gathering relevant competition information and data. Conduct annual reviews of relevant documents and update them as necessary to meet evolving operational requirements. Ensure timely and accurate dissemination of information to the media and broadcasters in accordance with agreed timelines. Communicate clearly and concisely with teams to ensure they understand their obligations and responsibilities. Maintain effective coordination with the host broadcaster. Liaise regularly with competition managers on team registration details. Maintain a clear understanding of stadium legacy broadcast infrastructure and identify areas requiring broadcast overlays. Good understanding of broadcast workflows and processes. Requirements and Qualifications 10 years’ experience in a broadcast production management role or media operations role. Degree in a related technical discipline or equivalent practical experience. A thorough understanding of Media and preferably Broadcast & Production workflows and user requirements. Team focused - able to work with complex stakeholders and adapted to changing organization objectives. Good communication skills. Able to maintain technical/operational documentation and training material. Technical Skills & Knowledge Establish and maintain productive relationships with host broadcasters, rights holders by overseeing their on-site, technical, and service requirements, such as studio reservations, commentary locations, and access to mixed zones. Establishing and periodically reviewing minimum broadcast standards, principles for live coverage, and technical specifications, including cabling, power supply, and production facilities for AFC competitions and events Developing operational procedures, manuals, and guidelines, while providing performance updates. Overseeing press conference rooms, media tribunes, and pitch-side photography positions to ensure operational readiness. Facilitating the administration of accreditation procedures for media representatives, photographers, and non-rights holders. Managing requests from international and local media and facilitating interviews with players and team officials. Passionate about media and football? Join us at AFC and lead broadcast operations that bring the game to millions. Apply today!
industries: Spectator Sports, Sports Teams and Clubs, and Performing Arts and Spectator Sports
